Record Class LogMetrics.Counter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics.Counter
Record Components:
name - counter name, as passed to a counter method like LogMetrics.errorCounter(String, long).
level - how much this counter matters - not a log level routing decision, just a signal of significance, mirroring the counter method it came from (e.g. System.Logger.Level.ERROR for LogMetrics.errorCounter(String, long), System.Logger.Level.WARNING for LogMetrics.warnCounter(String, long), System.Logger.Level.INFO for LogMetrics.infoCounter(String, long)).
count - current value.
Enclosing interface:
LogMetrics
public static record LogMetrics.Counter(String name, System.Logger.Level level, long count) extends Record
A single named counter's current value, as returned by LogMetrics.counters().
